notes.title: Version 707
notes.notes: This version allows games in progress to be resumed from the main menu, as well as a number of miscellaneous tweaks and bug fixes. It also contains background groundwork for future revisions and features.

notes.title: Version 703
notes.notes:
This update includes the following:


Fixed a bug where you couldn't select turn end when confronted with no placement options with a non-rolled dice
Fixed a crash bug when unassigning purchased dice
Fixed some bugs when undoing a dice purchase
Fixed a bug with unbought dice remaining assigned to realms
Fixed some miscellaneous UI bugs
Resources now restack to prevent multiple resources being stacked on the same slot

notes.title: Version 699
notes.notes:
This update includes the following:


 The ability to undo creation of virtual dice
 Unassigning a dice will now also remove any virtual dice that you could no longer afford because of the unassign - previously you could exploit this to create "free" dice
 Fixed the bug preventing the "Full of Stars" achievement from being achievable
 Fixed some potential bugs with achieving Charterstone and Between Two Cities star awards
 Some background groundwork for future updates

notes.title: Update notes for version 686
notes.notes:
My goal is to bring to life a game I love in a new medium and your feedback is really, really helpful in helping me do that for you. Working on any game is a more difficult job than you might imagine, and as just one guy the task is even more difficult. 

This project is primarily a labor of love for me - I have approached every decision along the path with the priority of making the experience as nice as possible for as many people as possible, and I will be continuing to work on Rolling Realms so that I can deliver on that goal.

I'm keen to encourage you to keep the constructive feedback coming so that I can continue to use that feedback to achieve that goal of making the game the experience I set out to give you all, so thank you for the kind comments and thank you for the feedback.

If you find a way I can improve the experience then of course I will welcome hearing it so that I can ensure you guys have the game I want you to have.

This patch:


 fixes some achievement bugs that slipped past the beta testers
 enables a toggle that lets you switch between "performance mode" that makes animation as smooth and responsive as possible and "battery mode" which will reduce the amount the game leans on your your computer.


Next patch will address the rule mis-implementation that incorrectly means you can spend dice you have bought with resources on buying more resources, as well as improving the AI players.

Thanks again everyone!

notes.title: Rolling Realms Release
notes.notes:
Hey gamers! We're excited to announce the release of the digital edition of Stonemaier Games' Rolling Realms.

We look forward to hearing your thoughts as you explore the Realms, and to finding ways to continuously improve your experience.
